name: Ginger & Spice Festival
description: Free community festival celebrating Market Drayton's gingerbread, culinary heritage and social history, with food, heritage and entertainment.

name: Sounds in the Square – Wellington – 26 September
description: Free live music in Wellington Market Square. The 26 September session is explicitly listed by Wellington Town Council and features Funky Town.

name: Board Games for Families – Oswestry Library – 26 September
description: Free all-ages board games session with classic games, newer favourites and family activities. Runs on the last Saturday of the month; next date after September is 31 October. No booking required.

name: Mansion Highlight Tour – BSL Interpreted – Attingham Park
description: BSL-interpreted guided highlight tour of Attingham Park Mansion's Ground Floor. The event ticket is free but normal Attingham admission applies. Booking is essential, with a maximum of eight people; bookings close at 08:00 on the day. Children are welcome when accompanied by an adult.
accessibility: BSL interpreted. Important access limitation: there is no level access to the Mansion Ground Floor. The nearest toilets are in the West Pavilion; contact Attingham for individual access queries.
parking_transport: Designated blue-badge parking is available at Attingham Park. The Mansion is about a 10–15 minute walk from Visitor Reception; arrive at least 15 minutes before the tour.
age_guidance: Children welcome with an adult; no minimum age stated

name: Rockspring Community Choir charity concert
description: Rockspring Community Choir performs music from shows and popular songs, including sing-along sections, in support of Working Together, Ludlow.

name: Song Sung Blue – Trefonen Village Hall
description: Community cinema screening of the 12A musical drama Song Sung Blue. Adult tickets £5; under-18s £2.50. Arts Alive states arrival from 19:00, with a bar and café available during the interval.

name: Audio Thieves – Albert's Shed Southwater
description: Audio Thieves live at Albert's Shed Southwater. Official venue listing states free entry before 9pm and £5 general admission after 9pm.

name: Acton Scott Heritage Farm Harvest Festival
description: Traditional Harvest Festival bringing harvest customs to life with music, heavy horses, decorated harvest wagon, farm activities and Church Stretton Accordion Band.

name: Fungus Foray – The Old Racecourse
description: Guided fungi walk around The Old Racecourse with fungi expert John Hughes, exploring the variety of fungi found in grass, leaf litter and woodland and their role in local ecosystems.

name: Planting Words – National Poetry Day
description: An informal National Poetry Day gathering inviting people to share favourite nature-inspired poems or their own work. Speaking slots can be taken on the night. The official listing describes the event as pay-as-you-feel, with refreshments available.

name: Hedgehogs – one of Britain’s best-loved mammals
description: Heather Chase from Hokey Pokey Hedgehog Rescue shares practical knowledge about hedgehog care, the challenges hedgehogs face and ways people can help them in gardens and local communities.

name: Third Class: A Titanic Story
description: A one-man play based on Titanic survivor Edward Dorking, followed by a live Q&A. Official venue listing gives £15 standard and £13.50 concession.

name: Pumpkinfest – Park Hall Farm – 2 October
description: Family Halloween event with a pumpkin for every paying child to carve and take home, plus Pumpkin Alley, The Little Scare House, a Spooky Trail, games and Park Hall's usual farm, animal, indoor and outdoor play activities. Runs 10:00–17:00 on 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 16, 17 and 18 October, then daily 23 October–1 November 2026. Online adult/child 2–16 price £14.95; onsite £16.95; under-2s free.
age_guidance: Family event; child ticket 2–16, under-2s free

name: Shropshire Oktoberfest – Friday
description: Friday session of Shropshire Oktoberfest with independent beers, ciders and spirits, street food, live music and entertainment. Event is primarily adult-focused.
parking_transport: Shrewsbury bus station is about a 10-minute walk; Shrewsbury railway station about a 15-minute walk.

name: Friends of Mortimer Forest Variety Show
description: Alistair McGowan and local performers present an evening of music, words, comedy, poetry, magic and Mortimer Forest history, raising funds for Friends of Mortimer Forest.
source_name: Ludlow Assembly Rooms / Friends of Mortimer Forest

name: Harper Adams University Open Day – 3 October
description: Undergraduate and postgraduate open day at Harper Adams University, with course hubs, opportunities to speak with tutors and lecturers, and campus tours.

name: 1940s Living History Weekend – Whittington Castle
description: 1940s living-history weekend with authentic displays, historic vehicles and re-enactors at Whittington Castle. The organiser describes it as suitable for the whole family.

name: Gobowen Library Board Games Club – 3 October
description: Free board games club for ages 8+. Runs on the first Saturday of each month. Official listing says to just call in; next recurrence after this is 7 November.

name: Shropshire Oktoberfest – Saturday
description: Saturday session of Shropshire Oktoberfest with local drinks producers, street food, live music, comedy, silent disco and Carpool Karaoke.
parking_transport: Shrewsbury bus station is about a 10-minute walk; Shrewsbury railway station about a 15-minute walk.

name: Harvest Swap & Sale at Gratitude Cafe
description: Community harvest swap and sale for seeds, cuttings, fruit, vegetables, chutneys and preserves, accompanied by a specially themed cafe menu. The official listing gives a 13:00 start but no end time.

name: Market Drayton Oktoberfest
description: Unticketed Oktoberfest across participating Market Drayton pubs with German beer, food and entertainment. Food and drink purchased separately.

name: Battle of the Bands – Heat One
description: Heat One of Albert's Shed's Battle of the Bands competition for emerging original bands from Telford and the surrounding area.

name: Dar Williams + Heather Maloney – The Hive
description: Dar Williams performs at The Hive with support from Heather Maloney. Official listing states doors 7pm and the gig starts 7:45pm.

name: Orchard Day at Dudmaston Hall – 4 October
description: Family-friendly apple pressing in the orchard. The event is free but normal venue admission applies for non-members; National Trust members and under-5s have free entry. Booking not needed.
accessibility: Takes place outdoors in the orchard, which the National Trust states is accessible for wheelchair users.
age_guidance: Children welcome; under 5s free venue admission

name: Wildlife Poetry Walk & Talk – Cuan Wildlife Rescue
description: Wildlife and poetry walk at Eaton Manor followed by an indoor talk from Cuan Wildlife Rescue founder Megan Morris-Jones, with tea, coffee and cake. The walk is on uneven ground and can be shortened if preferred. Dogs are not permitted.
accessibility: The organiser asks visitors with accessibility requirements to contact them in advance; the walking route is over uneven ground.
parking_transport: Free parking is available on site.
